lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice giving a simple but B2-like reaction to a film or event with reasons and limits.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Talking after seeing a film, exhibition, or local cultural event.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Evaluating an experience, explaining why it worked, and naming one limitation.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a film they watched and explain what they liked, what was weaker, and who might enjoy it.

main_focus.name: evaluation with det som fungerade bäst var att
main_focus.description: Use evaluation frames to connect a reaction to a concrete reason or feature.
model_examples: Det som fungerade bäst var att berättelsen kändes trovärdig.
Det som var svagare var tempot i mitten.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use evaluation frames naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use review words and chunks that support practical cultural conversation.

dialogue_shape.opening: They mention the shared experience and give a first reaction.
dialogue_shape.middle: They explain what worked, what was weaker, and give a reason for each reaction.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide who they would recommend it to.

target_complexity.repetition: evaluation frames should recur with natural variation

focus: the overall reaction to the film or event
the reason one part worked well
